title: Phase 5 Configuration, Policy Resolution, and Lockfile Adversarial Cases

cases.description: A project layer sets allowExperimental: true above the builtin false baseline
A layer loosens network.mode from deny to allowlist
A higher layer adds a connector not inherited from the lower allowlist
A layer sets allowPaidServices: true
A layer raises maxBundleKilobytes above the current constraint
A denied connector is stripped from the effective allowlist
Layers add required approvals; union preserved
A policy document contains an unknown rules field
config.yaml repeats a mapping key
config.yaml contains an anchor/alias token (e.g. &a [*a])
config.yaml contains .nan or .inf which the JSON schema would coerce to null
config.json repeats a key (last-wins would hide a conflict)
Configuration attempts a __proto__ / constructor / prototype key
config.yaml contains an unknown top-level field
Both config.yaml and config.json exist
No configuration file exists
Reordering preference lists does not change the config digest
configId violates the lowercase-kebab pattern
A lock input contains a token/secret/password-like string
A lock input contains an absolute path
A bound lock field is modified without recomputing the digest
Reordering connectors or unavailable entries does not change the lock digest
Changing only generatedAt does not change the lock digest
Lockfile writes are atomic (temp file + rename, no partial reads)
lock create is asked to write through a symlink output path
lock create output path has a symlinked directory component
lock create output path contains a .. segment
lock create refuses to overwrite an existing output without --force
A config or snapshot digest change makes lock check exit non-zero
A locked connector missing from current is a critical drift
lock inspect / lock check never write to disk
